purpose: Fallback to plain ASCII for terminals without UTF-8, replacing every special character by exactly one plain character so the layout stays in place.
details: The table maps box-drawing, symbols, arrows, accented letters and similar to one ASCII character each; any other non-ASCII letter becomes its plain letter, anything else '?'. A test checks that every special character used in the code and content is in the table (CLAUDE.md: new characters must be added here).
module_docstring: Terugval naar gewone ASCII-tekens voor terminals zonder UTF-8.

constants.name: _ASCII
constants.explanation: The one-to-one replacements of special characters.

functions.name: _gewoon
functions.docstring: Een letter met een accent wordt de letter zelf (é → e); iets anders onbekends wordt '?'.
functions.explanation: One character to plain ASCII: a letter with an accent becomes the plain letter, anything unknown '?'.

functions.name: naar_ascii
functions.explanation: A text to ASCII using the table and the plain-letter fallback.
